title: Perplexity Teammates, Airbnb's 2027 AI Agent, OpenAI IPO Talk & NDA Shift

opening.say: It's Friday, November 6, 2026. Here are four stories.

news.label: Perplexity launches always-on Teammates AI agents for work
points: Perplexity launched Teammates, always-on AI agents for work.
Teammates can take on multiple roles in a workspace.
It requires the $200 per month Max plan.
details: Teammates pull existing projects, skills, and memory from Perplexity tools.
They integrate with Perplexity Computer, which deploys agents on your device.
CEO Aravind Srinivas says every org could have hundreds of teammates.

lines.say: Perplexity has launched work-focused AI agents called Teammates.
lines.show: Perplexity launches Teammates AI agents for work.

lines.say: They run 24/7 and can take on multiple roles in a workspace.
lines.show: Always-on agents, multiple roles in one workspace.

lines.say: Teammates require the $200 per month Max plan.

link.title: Perplexity launches its own take on AI agents for work
link.description: Perplexity is taking on OpenAI and Anthropic.

news.label: Airbnb plans AI travel agent for first half of 2027
points: Airbnb will launch an AI travel agent in the first half of 2027.
The agent uses a travel-specific interface, not just chat.
It draws from hundreds of travel interface components.
details: The agent helps plan trips, compare options, and manage bookings.
CEO Brian Chesky says 80% of travelers enjoy researching trips.
Components include maps, photos, comparisons, calendars, and itineraries.

lines.say: Airbnb says its AI travel agent arrives in the first half of 2027.
lines.show: Airbnb AI travel agent: first half of 2027.

lines.say: It uses a custom interface with maps, photos, and itineraries.
CEO Brian Chesky says 80% of travelers enjoy researching trips.
lines.show: Chesky: 80% of travelers enjoy trip research.

link.title: Airbnb says it's launching an AI travel agent in the first half of 2027 | TechCrunch
link.description: Airbnb says its upcoming AI agent will help travelers plan trips, compare options, manage bookings, and get assistance throughout their stay.

news.label: OpenAI president says company could be IPO ready in 2027
points: Greg Brockman said OpenAI could be IPO ready in 2027.
Enterprise is now the majority of OpenAI's revenue.
OpenAI saw 70% quarterly growth in annualized revenue in Q3.
details: Brockman spoke at a Wall Street Journal tech conference on Wednesday.
He said Q1 and Q2 were rough, but Q3 picked up.
Enterprise previously accounted for around 30% of total revenue.

lines.say: OpenAI president Greg Brockman says the company could be IPO ready in 2027.
lines.show: Brockman: OpenAI could be IPO ready in 2027.

lines.say: Enterprise is now the majority of OpenAI's revenue.
lines.show: Enterprise now majority of OpenAI revenue.

lines.say: OpenAI saw 70% quarterly growth in annualized revenue in Q3.
lines.show: Q3: 70% quarterly growth in annualized revenue.

link.title: OpenAI president Greg Brockman says company could be IPO ready in 2027 | TechCrunch
link.description: Speaking at a Wall Street Journal tech conference on Wednesday, the executive touted how the company had been gaining ground in the enterprise market, where rival Anthropic had already successfully made inroads.

news.label: OpenAI won't use NDAs with public officials on data centers
points: OpenAI won't use NDAs with public officials for data center projects.
It will pay the full cost of electricity it uses.
Every compute campus will have a local compact.
details: The announcement follows midterms where voters opposed data center expansion.
OpenAI allows only narrow protections for security and trade secrets.
It will publish expected jobs and report on hiring.

link.description: OpenAI wants to work more closely with local communities.
